identity.evidence: The Booked Events listing (bookedevents.co.uk/businesses/paint-and-pour/) returned HTTP 200 on 27 Oct 2026. It is marked 'Not Verified', shows 'Est.2015', '90 High St, Epping CM16 4AE', 'Price from £350 per event' and 'Listed on Dec 15, 2024', and its thumbnail is paint_and_Pour_thumb.jpg. It matches the Eventbrite organiser 'Paint & Pour' (eventbrite.co.uk/o/bryony-doran-28148057737, whose bio begins 'I started Paint & Pour…') on four points. (1) Both logos share one distinctive design: an arched serif 'Paint and Pour' wordmark over a single-line drawing of a wine glass and a paintbrush, with the brush's line running out of the glass base. Booked Events shows a black version in a ring; Eventbrite shows a terracotta version on paper. (2) The Booked Events thumbnail shows a curly-haired host with a microphone beside a Scream-style canvas, in a venue with pink-lit wine shelves and neon. One of the Eventbrite event-page photos (image 1120464843) shows a group holding Scream paintings in the same pink-neon venue, and the Eventbrite hero photo shows the same woman. This is visual judgement. (3) Both are guided paint-and-wine nights in Epping High Street. The Eventbrite events are at Carpino Lounge, 183 High Street, Epping CM16 (also The Royal Forest, Ranger's Road, E4 7QH). (4) Event pages say 'Follow on instagram @_paint_and_Pour_', and the organiser socials (website and instagram) both point to instagram.com/_paint_and_pour_/. Two directory details remain unconfirmed: the founding year 2015 and the 90 High St address. Namesakes ruled out: unrelated 'Paint and Pour' events in the USA, Australia and South Korea (e.g. daegu.armymwr.com) and 'Easely Created' on Ticket Tailor. paintandpour.co.uk is a parked domain whose HTML just runs a JS redirect to /lander. No official website was found.

about.text: Paint & Pour was started by its organiser, Bryony. She says most people haven't picked up a paintbrush since school and should, preferably with a glass of wine in the other hand.
Guests arrive, get a drink and find an easel. They are then guided through the painting one step at a time, with music on. No experience is needed.
Canvas, paints, brushes and aprons are all provided. Guests can come with friends, with a date or on their own.
The organiser says the events usually sell out and asks people to follow the Eventbrite page for new dates.
Public Paint & Pour Nights run at Carpino Lounge, 183 High Street, Epping. The event page describes them as a sip and paint night in Epping, with step-by-step instruction from artist Bryony.

Each night is a 3-hour guided session. Doors open at 6:40pm. The agenda is check-in at 7pm, painting from 7:30pm, and a 'Mini Gallery & Photo Time' at the end. Guests get a complimentary drink on arrival and take their painting home.
Under-18s are admitted with a parent or legal guardian. Tickets are non-refundable, but the FAQ offers a transfer to an event on another date.
Paint & Pour Nights are also held at The Royal Forest, Ranger's Road, London E4 7QH. The event page describes them as a sip and paint night in Chingford.
The Booked Events listing, marked 'Not Verified', puts Paint and Pour under Unique Services as a provider of paint and wine events for groups of 10 to 100.

services.name: Paint & Pour Night (Epping)
services.description: A 3-hour guided sip-and-paint night at Carpino Lounge, 183 High Street, Epping CM16. It includes a complimentary drink on arrival, all painting supplies, and step-by-step instruction from artist Bryony. Guests take their painting home, and it is suitable for beginners. Tickets are £35: the event page's structured data has lowPrice/highPrice 35.0 GBP, and the organiser page shows '35.00 GBP'. Listed dates include 13 Nov 2026 and 4 Dec 2026 (event 1990784406751).

images.description: Bryony, smiling, presents a group's finished canvases of Monet's 'Woman with a Parasol' on table easels in a bar with exposed brick walls. The best high-resolution hero candidate.

About 20 guests hold up their finished 'The Scream'-style paintings in a lounge with pink neon signage and lit wine shelves, the same venue as the Booked Events thumbnail. A wide, high-resolution group shot.
Bryony hosting with a microphone beside an easel holding a 'Scream'-style painting, with pink-lit wine shelves and guests behind.

A venue set up before a session: blank canvases on table easels, paint palettes, brushes and Van Gogh 'Sunflowers' reference prints along a long table with a green cloth, green walls and a window hung with wisteria.
A group of about 20 guests holding up their finished cat-portrait paintings in a restaurant with a patterned tile floor. Low resolution.
Guests painting landscapes at a long table in a room with floral wallpaper, gilt-framed paintings and globe pendant lights. Low resolution.

record.instagramAccess: Re-checked 27 Oct 2026 with one plain unauthenticated GET to https://www.instagram.com/_paint_and_pour_/ (desktop browser user agent, no cookies). It returned HTTP 200 with no redirect and a ~505 KB generic app shell titled 'Instagram'. There was no og:title, og:description, og:image or biography, and no post data, so the profile and posts cannot be seen without logging in. I did not retry. The handle is confirmed by the Eventbrite organiser socials and by the event text 'Follow on instagram @_paint_and_Pour_'.
gaps: No official website found. The organiser's Eventbrite 'website' field points to the Instagram profile. paintandpour.co.uk is a parked domain (a JS redirect to /lander) with no link to this business. paintandpour.uk, paintandpourepping.co.uk and paintandpourepping.com did not resolve.

Founding year 2015 (from the directory) is not corroborated. The earliest dated image asset was uploaded 10 Sept 2025. The Eventbrite organiser page's embedded JSON shows hostingYears '6 years', totalEvents 44 and attendeesHosted 241, which suggests Eventbrite activity since about 2020. That covers the account, not necessarily this trading name, and still does not reach 2015. Confirm the year with the business.

The directory address '90 High St, Epping CM16 4AE' is not corroborated by any source from the business, and web searches found no venue tied to it. The business's public events are at Carpino Lounge, 183 High Street, Epping CM16 and The Royal Forest, Ranger's Road, London E4 7QH. It runs at partner venues, so there is no evidence of premises of its own. Do not publish 90 High St as its address without confirmation.

The directory figures 'Price from £350 per event' and '10–100 guests' come from the 'Not Verified' Booked Events listing, not from the business. The only price the business publishes is £35 per ticket for public nights on Eventbrite.

Private or mobile bookings are unverified. Search-engine snippets of ClassBento (classbento.co.uk/paint-and-pour, /paint-and-pour-night, /c/cbdj) say the teacher can travel within 10 miles of Epping for private classes and give class sizes of 1–30 or 5–30. Those pages returned HTTP 403 when re-checked, so they are not used as sources.
The business does not state any event types (weddings, birthdays, corporate, etc.) in a source that could be fetched, so eventTypes is left empty. The Booked Events 'Perfect For' field is also empty.

No video footage found. The Booked Events listing and the four Eventbrite pages (organiser plus three events) have no <video>, mp4, YouTube or Vimeo embeds. Instagram needs login. tiktok.com/@_paint_and_pour_ returned statusCode 10221 (no public account). Web searches found no YouTube, Vimeo or Facebook presence. Ask the business for footage or check Instagram while logged in.

No SVG logo was found, only rasters. The Booked Events PNG (1000px, transparent, black with a ring) and the Eventbrite profile JPEG (506px, terracotta on a paper texture) are different renditions. Ask the business for a vector master.
The raw cdn.evbuc.com originals are served with content-type binary/octet-stream. Byte sniffing confirmed they are valid JPEG/PNG, so re-encode or sniff the type when importing.

Few own photos are high-resolution: two Eventbrite photos (3616x4156 and 3530x1713) and two Booked Events photos of about 1000px. The two Eventbrite 'Media' photos are only 480x640. Image 1185859190 is a byte-identical re-upload of the 3616x4156 hero (same 1,434,689 bytes).
Excluded: the Booked Events 'View all photos' gallery holds five OpenArt AI-generated images (openart-image_*.jpg). They are not this business's work.

The tagline 'Unwind, Create. Connect' is copied, punctuation included, from text inside the Eventbrite cover banner image, not from HTML text. The event pages' HTML summary is 'Sip wine, paint, and unwind – no experience needed!'.
The Booked Events listing says 'Last Updated: February 7, 2025' and lists no website, phone, email or social links for the business.
